nodes.text: For inspired incantations through words become bringers of pleasure and removers of grief; for the power of the incantation, mingling with the opinion of the soul, beguiles it and persuades it and changes it by witchcraft. Of witchcraft and magic two arts have been discovered, which are errors of the soul and deceptions of opinion.

The power of speech stands in the same relation to the ordering of the soul as the ordering of drugs to the nature of bodies. For just as different drugs draw different humours out of the body, and some put an end to disease, others to life, so too among speeches some cause grief, others delight, others fear, others put their hearers in a bold frame of mind, and others drug and bewitch the soul with some evil persuasion.
